definition: Unique identifier of one invoice (one billing cycle for one customer).
Identifier of the customer billed on this invoice.
Identifier of that customer's HarborLink subscription.
Identifier of the billing order behind this invoice.
Date the invoice was issued.
Date by which the invoice should be paid.
Amount billed on this invoice, in euros.
Payment status stored on the invoice workbook. It should agree with payment_status; both are kept so a mismatch can be checked.
Billing month of the invoice, written YYYY-MM.
Name of the person who is the HarborLink customer.
Name of the customer's company.
Commercial segment of the customer (smb, mid-market, enterprise). Empty when the customer file has no segment for that customer.
Country of the customer, as an ISO two-letter code.
Date the customer first subscribed to HarborLink.
Plan of the subscription: starter, standard or premium.
Monthly price of the plan, in euros. It should match amount on these invoices.
Date this subscription started.
Identifier of the payment row attached to this invoice.

Finance snapshot on 12 September 2026. paid = a payment_date is recorded (including paid after the due date). unpaid = no payment yet, and the due date has not passed. overdue = no payment, and the due date has already passed. overdue is not 'paid late'.
Date a payment was recorded. Empty when no payment has been recorded (unpaid or overdue invoices).
Number of CRM contacts for this customer during the invoice month. Zero means no contact that month, not a missing value.
Number of those CRM contacts that were payment reminders.
Number of those CRM contacts that were complaints.
Number of those CRM contacts that reported a payment issue.
Number of those CRM contacts that went through email.
Payment status returned by the September API snapshot for this invoice_id. Empty for invoices that are not in that snapshot (every month except September).
Number of days between invoice_date and due_date (the payment window).
Number of days between invoice_date and payment_date. Empty when there is no payment_date.
True when a payment_date exists and is after due_date. False if the invoice was paid on time, or if it was never paid.
True when payment_status is unpaid or overdue. The mean of this column is the outstanding rate.
Whole months between signup_date and this invoice_date. Zero in the customer's first billing month.
